query: My AWS bill is $4k/month and I think I'm over-provisioned — optimize my Qovery costs
expected_behavior: Loads reference/phase1-context-gathering.md and gathers the user's business context (seasonal patterns, growth stage, reliability needs)
Calls /organization/{orgId}/currentCost and /cluster/{clusterId}/currentCost to baseline current spend
Pulls 7-day CPU and memory metrics per service via the metrics API
Walks the 7 dimensions in reference/phase2-optimization-dimensions.md and produces concrete recommendations with $-savings estimates
References reference/pricing/aws.md for instance-type costs (does not invent prices)
Generates the Phase 3 cost report (Markdown + CSV) and confirms each change before applying

query: Can I save money by stopping my dev environments at night?
expected_behavior: Reads reference/phase2-optimization-dimensions.md (Dimension 4: lifecycle scheduling)
Proposes a deployment rule with a stop schedule (e.g. weekdays 8pm) and a start schedule (e.g. weekdays 8am)
Estimates savings as approximately (16h non-business + 48h weekend) / 168h = ~62% of the dev environment cost
Warns the user that scheduled stops can cause cold-start delay if the user starts work before the start window
Asks for confirmation before applying

query: Convert all my dev databases from managed RDS to container mode
expected_behavior: Reads reference/phase2-optimization-dimensions.md (Dimension 3: database mode)
Lists each affected database with current mode, instance type, and estimated monthly cost using reference/pricing/aws.md
Warns that container mode loses managed backups, multi-AZ, and automated patching
Recommends keeping production on MANAGED
Applies the change per database after individual confirmation, not as a single batch action

query: Right-size my production cluster — we have Qovery observability enabled, use real metrics
expected_behavior: Checks metrics_parameters.enabled via GET /organization/{orgId}/cluster/{clusterId} before choosing the right-sizing method
Since observability is enabled, loads reference/phase2b-krr-rightsizing.md instead of hand-computing from the metrics API
Runs 'qovery cluster analysis cost-recommendation' with the Qovery flag set (P99 CPU, OOM-aware memory buffers, --allow-hpa) and only allowlisted --cmd-arg values
Does not fetch a kubeconfig or install KRR locally: the analysis runs server-side and is read-only
Maps KRR rows back to Qovery services and applies the Phase 2 guardrails (minimum thresholds, seasonal peaks, growth buffers)
Tags the recommendations as KRR-based in the Phase 3 report and falls back to Dimension 1 formulas if observability is off and no Prometheus URL is available
